title: Partition Labels
prompt:
Partition string `s` into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part. Return the sizes of the parts in order.

**Example**: `"ababcbacadefegdehijhklij"` → `[9,7,8]`.

Greedy: a part must extend to the last occurrence of every letter it contains.
hints: Precompute the last index of each letter.
Scan with a running `end` = max last-index of every letter seen in the current part.
When the scan index reaches `end`, close the part and record its size.

solution.explanation: A part can end only after the last appearance of every letter inside it, so `end` grows to the farthest such index. Reaching `end` means no letter in this part appears later — the greedy earliest possible cut, which maximizes the number of parts. O(n).
